# Elizabeth

deceased

## Overview

- **Role:** missionary (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Gardners’Call P11](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0011)</sub>
- **Status:** deceased (since v4)  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 2 THE HOUSE OF DREAMS P25](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0025), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL P65](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0065)</sub>
- **Family:** [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) (parent), [Sarah](../character/sarah.md) (cousin)

## Appearance

In her youth, Elizabeth possessed great beauty. Despite having numerous opportunities to marry, she never did.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL P63](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0063)_

## Personality

A universally liked individual, Elizabeth is known as a creature of mirth. Despite her joyful disposition, she tends to live in the past.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P48](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0048), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P4](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0004), [v5 CHAPTER VII. A FISHY EPISODE P34](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0034)_

## History

Elizabeth remodeled her house fifteen years ago, which included having a fireplace installed. In her youth, she wrote stories before leaving to become a missionary. During a past visit to her uncle in [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown), she attended a great ball where the Prince of Wales danced with her.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P11](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0011), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P25](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0025), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P61](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0061), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P63](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0063), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P65](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0065), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL P63](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0063), +23 more_
